name: dsh-exec-extension
description: dsh bundle: replace headless-startup with per-invocation --model / --effort / --provider, without writing settings

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir js/generated --out-name native target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/dsh_exec_extension.wasm && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('js/generated/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
scripts.test: cargo test && node --test js/startup.test.js js/native.test.js js/patch.test.js
